name: incorporated_in
question: In which jurisdiction is the entity incorporated (where is its registered head office)?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the entity's incorporation or registered head office (Japan: 本店又は主たる事務所); certificate of incorporation, company register.

name: managed_in
question: In which jurisdiction is the entity's effective management (central management and control) exercised?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the place of effective management: CN 实际管理机构 (EIT Law art. 2), HK normally managed or controlled (s50AAC), SG control and management of the business (s2); board minutes, location of senior management.

name: domicile_in
question: In which jurisdiction is the individual domiciled (permanent home, 住所)?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the individual's domicile: CN 住所 (IIT Law art. 1), JP 住所 (ITA art. 2); household registration, family and economic ties.

name: days_present
question: How many days was the individual present in the jurisdiction during the tax year that contains the payment date?
meaning: Days of presence in the tax year of the jurisdiction being tested (CN, TH: calendar year; HK: year of assessment; SG: the year preceding the year of assessment); immigration records.

name: days_present_two_years
question: How many days was the individual present in Hong Kong in the two consecutive years of assessment that include the current one?
meaning: Days of presence in Hong Kong over two consecutive years of assessment, one of them the current year (s50AAC(1)(a)(ii)(B)); immigration records.

name: ordinarily_resides
question: Does the individual ordinarily reside in the jurisdiction (a home there, not merely visiting)?
meaning: HK s50AAC(1)(a)(i) 'ordinarily resides in Hong Kong'; SG s2(1) 'resides in Singapore except for such temporary absences'; home, family, habitual abode.

name: residence_years
question: For how many continuous years up to the payment date has the individual had a place of residence (居所) in Japan?
meaning: Years of continuous 居所 in Japan (ITA art. 2(1)(iii): one year or more); residence records.

name: non_permanent_resident
question: Is the individual a non-permanent resident of Japan (no Japanese nationality and domicile or residence in Japan for five years or less within the last ten years)?
meaning: ITA art. 2(1)(iv) 非永住者; nationality and residence history.

name: holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payer's capital (voting shares where the clause says so) does the payee hold directly at the payment date?
meaning: Ratio of the payer's shares held directly by the payee, in %; shareholder register. The clause decides capital or voting shares.

name: holding_months
question: For how many months has the payee continuously held the shares at the payment date?
meaning: Months of continuous holding of the shares that carry the dividend, counted to the payment (or entitlement) date; share register, transfer documents.

name: payer_listed
question: Are the payer's shares listed on a stock exchange?
meaning: Payer's shares publicly issued and listed (CN EIT Reg. art. 83 公开发行并上市流通; JP SMA 9-3 上場株式等); exchange listing.

name: payee_listed
question: Is the payee a company listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand?
meaning: TH Revenue Code s65 bis (10)(a) บริษัทจดทะเบียน (listed company); SET listing.

name: cross_holding
question: Does the payer hold shares in the payee, directly or indirectly?
meaning: TH s65 bis (10)(b): the paying company must not hold shares in the receiving company directly or indirectly; shareholder registers of both.

name: payer_industrial
question: Is the payer a company engaged in an industrial undertaking as defined in the Japan-Thailand convention?
meaning: JP-TH convention art. 10(2)(a) and the definition of industrial undertaking in art. 10; payer's business licence and accounts.

name: payer_tax_rate
question: What is the headline rate (%) of the income tax on company profits in the payer's jurisdiction at the time the dividend is received?
meaning: Applicable or highest rate of the tax on company profits in the payer's jurisdiction: HK s15N(6)(b) applicable rate, SG s13(9)(b) highest rate, TH RD 442 s4(2) rate of tax on net profit; the payer's tax law.

name: payer_etr
question: What is the payer's effective tax burden (%) on its profits for the year (tax actually borne divided by profits)?
meaning: Effective tax burden of the payer: CN 实际税负 (EIT Reg. art. 118), JP 租税負担割合 (SMA 66-6(5)), KR 실제부담세액 over 실제발생소득 (ITCA art. 27(1)(i), Enforcement Decree arts. 61-62: averages of the last three fiscal years); the payer's tax returns and accounts.

name: payer_income_taxed
question: Were the profits out of which the dividend is paid (or the dividend itself) actually subject to income tax in the payer's jurisdiction?
meaning: SG s13(9)(a) income subject to tax; HK s15N(2)(a) income or underlying profits subject to a qualifying similar tax; TH RD 442 s4(2) dividend from taxed net profit; the payer's tax assessment.

name: payer_fie
question: Is the payer a foreign-invested enterprise (外商投资企业) in mainland China?
meaning: MoF/STA Announcement 2026 No. 27 item 1; the payer's business licence and foreign-investment registration.

name: mne_entity
question: Is the payee an MNE entity (a member of a multinational enterprise group) carrying on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong?
meaning: HK s15H(1) MNE entity, s15I(3)(a); group structure chart and consolidated accounts.

name: family_company
question: Is the payer a family company (同族会社: three or fewer shareholder groups holding more than 50%)?
meaning: JP CTA art. 2(x) 同族会社; shareholder register.

name: payer_jur
question: In which jurisdiction is the payer resident?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the payer's residence, used for country lists (CN CFC white list); the payer's residence certificate.

name: resident_holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payer's shares (or votes, or dividend rights) is held in total by residents of the payee's jurisdiction?
meaning: CN EIT Reg. art. 117(1): resident enterprises and Chinese residents jointly hold more than 50%; JP SMA 66-6(2)(i): residents and domestic companies hold more than 50%; shareholder register of the payer.

name: paid_in_capital
question: What is the payee's paid-in capital at the end of the business year (JPY)?
meaning: JP CTA art. 66(2): the 19% rate applies only when capital is at most jp.final.sme_capital_max; company register.

name: parent_jur
question: In which jurisdiction is the person that holds 100% of the payee, directly or indirectly, resident?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the payee's 100% parent (STA 2018 No. 9 item 3); group structure chart, shareholder registers.

name: parent_holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payee is held, directly or indirectly, by that parent?
meaning: Percentage of the payee's shares held by the parent named in parent_jur; shareholder register.

name: parent_holding_months
question: For how many months before the dividend has the parent held that percentage without interruption?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 5: the holding ratio must be met at all times during the 12 months before the dividend; share register.

name: parent_treaty_not_worse
question: If the parent received the dividend directly, would its treaty benefit be at least as good as the payee's?
meaning: Item 3: the parent is a 'qualifying person' when the treaty between the source and parent_jur gives the same or a better dividend benefit than the payee's treaty; compare the dividend_rate parameters of the two pairs. Computed from the parameters, not asked.

name: payee_listed_in_partner
question: Is the payee a company listed on a stock exchange in its own jurisdiction (the treaty partner)?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 4(2): a listed resident company is beneficial owner without the factor analysis; exchange listing.

name: payee_is_government
question: Is the payee the government of the treaty partner?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 4(1).

name: passes_on_within_12m
question: Is the payee obliged, by contract or by established practice, to pass on more than half of the dividend to a resident of a third jurisdiction within 12 months?
meaning: Unfavourable factor of STA 2018 No. 9 item 2(1) (parameters cn.outbound_wht.bo_pass_on_share_max, bo_pass_on_months); shareholder agreements, prior distributions, bank records.

name: substantive_business
question: Does the payee carry on substantive business activities (manufacturing, distribution, management, or substantive management of its investments)?
meaning: Factor of STA 2018 No. 9 item 2(2); functions performed and risks borne; accounts, staff.

name: employees_in_jurisdiction
question: How many employees does the payee have in its jurisdiction?
meaning: Factor for economic substance (HK s15K(2)) and for beneficial ownership; payroll records.

name: premises_in_jurisdiction
question: Does the payee have premises of its own in its jurisdiction, not only a registered or secretary's address?
meaning: Factor for economic substance (HK s15K(2)); lease, office records.

name: specified_cfc
question: Is the payer a specified foreign related company (paper company, cash box or blacklisted-jurisdiction company under SMA 66-6(2)(ii))?
meaning: JP SMA 66-6(2)(ii) 特定外国関係会社; the payer's staff, premises, assets and income composition.

name: tiers
question: Through how many tiers of foreign companies is the credited foreign tax borne (the payer itself is tier 1)?
meaning: CN Caishui 2017 No. 84 item 2: at most five tiers of foreign companies, each held 20% or more; group structure chart.

name: received_in_jurisdiction
question: Is the dividend received in (remitted into) the payee's jurisdiction?
meaning: Remittance basis: HK s15I(3)(a) received in Hong Kong; SG s10(1) received in Singapore from outside Singapore; TH s41 paragraph 2 brought into Thailand; JP ITA 7(1)(ii) paid in or remitted to Japan. In planning the candidate structure decides it; for a recorded transaction the bank record.

name: payer_resident
question: Is the payer resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated?
meaning: Output of that jurisdiction's residence cell applied to the payer (its incorporated_in and managed_in); computed by the flow evaluator, not asked.

name: payee_resident
question: Is the payee resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated (for a treaty rule: in the treaty partner)?
meaning: Output of the residence cell of the payee's jurisdiction applied to the payee; computed by the flow evaluator, not asked.

name: payer_low_tax
question: Is the payer's effective tax burden low under the CFC rule of the shareholder's jurisdiction?
meaning: Computed by the caller from payer_etr and the parameters of the shareholder's jurisdiction, not asked. CN: payer_etr < cn.final.cit_rate x cn.cfc.low_tax_rate_share_max / 100 (EIT Reg. art. 118: below 50% of the 25% rate). KR: payer_etr <= the top rate of the kr.final.cit_bracket table x kr.cfc.low_tax_top_rate_share_max / 100 (ITCA art. 27(1)(i): at or below 70% of the highest rate of CIT art. 55).

name: other_taxable_income
question: What is the recipient's other net taxable income of the year, in the currency of the recipient's jurisdiction?
meaning: Net taxable income of the recipient for the year before adding this dividend, in the recipient jurisdiction's currency; sets the band of a schedule, also the HK two-tier and JP small-company schedules. Tax return of the previous year or a projection, labelled as such.

name: amount_payee_ccy
question: What is the gross dividend amount in the currency of the recipient's jurisdiction?
meaning: The dividend converted into the recipient jurisdiction's currency at the rate the recipient uses for its return; the library has no exchange rates, the conversion is the caller's. Used only by schedule rules.

name: concealment
question: Were facts concealed or disguised, or records falsified, in the return or withholding at issue?
meaning: Whether the understatement would be treated as evasion / fraud rather than an ordinary error: CN TCA art. 63, SG ITA s96, JP General Act s68. Selects the harsher penalty rules; unknown leaves the ceiling at the harsher figure.

name: negligence
question: Was the incorrect return made without reasonable excuse or through negligence?
meaning: SG ITA s95(2) fault standard (double penalty); the ordinary s95(1) penalty applies without fault.

name: overdue_months
question: How many months have passed since the payment deadline at the assessment date?
meaning: Months from the withholding / payment deadline to the date the exposure is assessed; the caller computes it from the deadline parameters and the assessment date. Drives time-dependent surcharges (HK s71(5A)).

name: voluntary_payment
question: Would the tax be paid voluntarily before any notice from the tax office and not in anticipation of an audit?
meaning: JP General Act s67(2): the non-payment additional tax falls from 10% to 5% for voluntary late payment.

name: return_filed
question: Was a return filed for the period in question?
meaning: TH Revenue Code: penalty of one time the tax on an assessment after a return (s22) versus two times where no return was filed (s26).

name: target_jur
question: In which jurisdiction is the company whose shares are transferred resident?
meaning: Jurisdiction code of the company transferred (the 'target'); set by the optimization layer for each transfer it evaluates.

name: target_in_jurisdiction
question: Is the company whose shares are transferred resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated?
meaning: True in the source cell (target_jur = cell jurisdiction), false in the transferor's home cell; set by eval_transfer, not asked.

name: transferor_resident
question: Is the transferor resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated?
meaning: Output of that jurisdiction's residence cell applied to the transferor (its transferor.* facts); computed by eval_transfer, not asked.

name: transferred_pct
question: What percentage of the company's share capital is transferred in this transaction (together with related persons in the same year)?
meaning: Share of the target's capital transferred; JP Cabinet Order art. 178(6)(ii) 5% test and treaty JP-SG art. 13(4)(b)(ii). Share transfer agreement.

name: property_rich_ratio
question: What percentage of the value of the company's shares derives, directly or indirectly, from immovable property situated in its jurisdiction?
meaning: Property-rich test of treaty Article 13 (50% or three-quarters) and of the CN group safe harbour (STA 2015 No. 7 item 6). Latest balance sheet or appraisal; 0 for a pure holding of operating companies without real estate.

name: indirect_transfer
question: Are the shares transferred those of a foreign holding company that itself holds the Chinese company, rather than the Chinese company's own shares?
meaning: Indirect transfer within STA 2015 No. 7 item 1; set by the move (which link of the chain is sold).

name: group_relation_pct
question: What percentage of the transferee does the transferor own (or vice versa, or both under a common parent), directly or indirectly?
meaning: Relation between transferor and transferee for the intra-group safe harbour of STA 2015 No. 7 item 6 (80%; 100% when property-rich). Group structure chart.

name: target_listed
question: Are the shares transferred listed on a recognised stock exchange and bought and sold on that exchange?
meaning: Listed-share exemptions: STA 2015 No. 7 item 5 (public market), treaty CN-HK art. 13(6), SG-TH art. 13(2). Exchange listing.

name: consideration_in_shares
question: Is the consideration for the transfer paid entirely in shares of the transferee or of a company it controls (not listed shares)?
meaning: STA 2015 No. 7 item 6(3): condition of the intra-group reorganisation safe harbour; an individual transferee or a cash deal fails it. Set by the planned deal; PLAN when undecided.

name: future_cn_tax_not_reduced
question: After this indirect transfer, would a later indirect transfer of the same Chinese taxable property bear Chinese income tax that is not lower than it would have borne without this transfer?
meaning: STA 2015 No. 7 item 6(2): condition of the intra-group reorganisation safe harbour. The optimization layer derives it by comparing the Chinese tax on a direct transfer of the Chinese company by the transferee with that by the transferor (treaty Article 13 position of each); PLAN when it cannot.

name: exit_assets_value
question: What is the total value in JPY of the securities and similar assets the individual holds at departure?
meaning: Japan ITA 60-2: value of the securities, silent-partnership interests and unsettled derivative positions held at departure, in JPY; brokerage statements, valuation of unlisted shares. The caller takes the gain as this value less the acquisition cost.

name: years_resident_last_10
question: For how many of the ten years before departure did the individual have a domicile or residence in Japan?
meaning: Japan ITA 60-2(5): total years of domicile or residence in Japan in the ten years before departure (periods under certain residence statuses are left out by cabinet order); residence records.

name: owner_safe_harbour
question: Is the payee held 100%, directly or through intermediate holders resident in China or in the payee's own jurisdiction, by the government, a listed company or resident individuals of the payee's own jurisdiction, throughout the 12 months before the dividend?
meaning: STA 2018 No. 9 item 4(4) with item 5: such a payee is beneficial owner without the factor analysis of item 2. Group structure chart and registers; the optimization layer derives it from the holding chain of a candidate.

name: claim_reported
question: Was the treatment at issue claimed openly, through the filing the rules require (for a Mainland treaty claim, the information report form of STA 2019 No. 35 art. 6 filed with the withholding return)?
meaning: Selects the penalty when a claimed treatment is later denied: Mainland STA 2019 No. 35 art. 16 recovers the tax with late-payment interest only where the claim was reported under art. 6; otherwise the withholding agent's fine of TCA art. 69 applies. A plan's own filing steps set it true.

name: conducts_business_in_jurisdiction
question: Does the individual conduct a business or business activity on their own account in the jurisdiction (not employment, personal investment or real estate investment)?
meaning: UAE Decree-Law 47/2022 art. 11(3)(c): a natural person who conducts a Business or Business Activity in the State is a Resident Person; Cabinet Decision 49/2023 art. 2(2): wage, Personal Investment income and Real Estate Investment income are not a Business of a natural person. Trade licence, invoices, business accounts.

name: held_in_business
question: Does the individual hold the shares that pay the dividend as part of a business conducted in the payee's jurisdiction (under a trade licence, or as a commercial business), rather than as a personal investment for their own account?
meaning: UAE Cabinet Decision 49/2023 art. 1: Personal Investment is investment activity for the personal account neither conducted through (nor requiring) a Licence nor a commercial business, and its income is outside Corporate Tax (art. 2(2)(b)); income related to the individual's UAE Business is taxable (Decree-Law art. 12(2)). Trade licence, books of the business, how the shares were acquired.

name: holding_period_intended
question: Will the payee keep the holding for at least the minimum holding period, counted from its acquisition, where the law accepts an intention to hold in place of a period already completed?
meaning: UAE Decree-Law art. 23(2)(a): the participation exemption needs the holding to be held, or intended to be held, for 12 months without interruption; income exempted on that intention is brought back if the holding is not kept (art. 23(10)). Set by the candidate structure (how long the plan keeps the shares); in a recorded transaction absent means false.

name: payer_nonqualifying_holdings_pct
question: What percentage of the payer's direct and indirect assets consists of shareholdings or other ownership interests that would not themselves qualify for the payee's participation exemption if the payee held them directly?
meaning: UAE Decree-Law art. 23(2)(d): at most 50% of the Participation's direct and indirect assets may be such interests; 0 for an operating company without shareholdings. Payer's balance sheet, group structure chart.

name: business_turnover
question: What is the individual's turnover for the calendar year from the businesses conducted in the jurisdiction (gross income, leaving out wages, personal investment and real estate investment income), in the jurisdiction's currency?
meaning: UAE Cabinet Decision 49/2023 art. 1 (Turnover: gross amount of income derived during a Gregorian calendar year) and art. 2: a natural person's Business is within Corporate Tax only above AED 1,000,000; invoices, accounts, in AED.

name: days_present_12m
question: On how many days was the individual present in the jurisdiction within the 12-month period being tested?
meaning: Days of presence within a 12-month period that need not coincide with the tax year, not necessarily consecutive: ID Income Tax Law art. 2(3)(a)(2) (more than 183 days within 12 months, counted from arrival per its elucidation); immigration records, passport stamps.

name: intends_to_reside
question: Is the individual staying in the jurisdiction during the tax year with the intention to reside there?
meaning: ID Income Tax Law art. 2(3)(a)(3): within a fiscal year staying in Indonesia with the intention to reside, judged by the circumstances (elucidation of art. 2(3)); residence or work permit, employment contract, family relocation, home.

name: dividend_reinvested
question: Is the whole dividend invested (or used for business activities) in the recipient's jurisdiction within the period and in the forms its law requires?
meaning: Reinvestment condition of an exemption: ID Income Tax Law art. 4(3)(f) (domestic dividends to resident individuals; foreign dividends to resident companies and individuals; period and instruments set by Minister of Finance regulation, not in the library; for a dividend from an unlisted foreign company the investment must precede any DGT assessment under art. 18(2), item 6). True only if the whole dividend is invested; split a partly invested dividend. In planning the candidate structure decides it; for a recorded transaction the investment records.

name: cfc_profit_reinvested
question: Will the shareholder invest in its jurisdiction, within the required period, dividends of the controlled foreign company amounting to at least the required share of that company's profit after tax?
meaning: ID Income Tax Law art. 4(3)(f)(2)(a) with items 4 and 5 and art. 18(2): dividends of an unlisted foreign company invested in Indonesia in at least id.cfc.invested_profit_share_min (30%) of its profit after tax, before any DGT assessment under art. 18(2), take the rest of that profit out of the deemed dividend. In planning the candidate structure decides it; for a recorded transaction the investment records.

name: not_ordinarily_resident
question: Is the individual, though resident in India for the tax year, not ordinarily resident there (non-resident in nine of the ten preceding tax years, 729 days or less in India in the seven preceding tax years, or a citizen / person-of-Indian-origin case of s6(13)(b)-(c))?
meaning: India s6(13) not-ordinarily-resident status of a resident individual for the tax year of the payment; such a person includes foreign income only when it is received in India or derived from a business controlled in or a profession set up in India (s5(1)(c)). Residence history (days in India per tax year), passport and immigration records.

name: dividend_distributed_onward
question: Does the recipient company itself distribute dividends at least equal to this dividend in time for the inter-corporate dividend deduction (India: at least one month before the due date of its return)?
meaning: India s148(1): a domestic company deducts dividends received from a domestic or foreign company up to the dividends it distributes at least one month before the due date of its return under s263(1); true when that onward distribution covers the whole dividend and has not been used for another deduction (s148(2)). In planning the candidate structure decides it (the holding company passes the dividend on); for a recorded transaction the board resolutions and payment records.

name: concessional_regime_elected
question: Has the recipient company opted for the concessional company tax rate of India's section 200 (22%) for the tax year?
meaning: India s200: a domestic company may opt, by the due date of its return, for tax at 22% on income computed without the deductions listed in s200(1); the option applies to later years and cannot be withdrawn (s200(5)-(6)). The company's return and option filing.

name: reference_year_turnover
question: What were the recipient company's total turnover or gross receipts in the reference year that the rate table names (India: tax year 2024-25 for tax year 2026-27), in the jurisdiction's currency?
meaning: Turnover test of a reduced company rate: India Finance Act 2026, First Schedule Part I-B, Paragraph E.I(i), 25% when the turnover or gross receipts of tax year 2024-25 do not exceed INR 400 crore (in.final.company_turnover_max). Audited accounts or the return of that year; in INR.

name: short_term_foreign_resident
question: Is the individual a foreign national whose domicile or residence in Korea totals five years or less within the ten years before the end of the tax year?
meaning: KR ITA art. 3(1) proviso: such a resident (외국인 거주자) is taxed on foreign-source income only when it is paid in Korea or remitted there (received_in_jurisdiction); nationality, entry and exit records.

name: payee_government_or_resident_owned
question: Is the payee a government or government institution of its jurisdiction, or a company whose capital is beneficially owned exclusively by that jurisdiction's governments, government institutions or individuals resident there, and controlled by them?
meaning: Entitlement-to-benefits clause of the AE-KR convention art. 26(1)-(2): for Korean tax only such UAE residents (and individuals) may claim the dividend article; shareholder registers up to the ultimate owners, government ownership records.

name: specified_small_corporation
question: Is the payee a corporation taxed on the separate rate table for companies whose main business is real-estate leasing or that meet the related statutory requirements (Korea: CIT art. 60-2(1)(i))?
meaning: KR CIT art. 55(1)(ii) with art. 60-2(1)(i): such domestic corporations (real-estate leasing as the main business or the other requirements of the Enforcement Decree, not in the library) are taxed on the table kr.final.cit_specified_bracket_*; articles of incorporation, revenue breakdown, shareholder register.

name: withheld_in_payee_jurisdiction
question: Is the dividend paid to the individual in the individual's own jurisdiction by a payer or paying agent that withholds that jurisdiction's income tax on it?
meaning: KR ITA art. 14(3)(vi) with art. 127: separate taxation reaches only dividends withheld under art. 127; a Korean company's dividend is withheld (payer_resident), a foreign dividend only when it is paid through a Korean paying agent such as a securities firm. In planning the collection route decides it; for a recorded payment, the account statement.

name: financial_income_total
question: What is the individual's total interest and dividend income of the year, including this dividend, in the currency of the individual's jurisdiction?
meaning: KR ITA art. 14(3)(vi): separate taxation while the year's interest and dividend income (without art. 17(1)(viii) dividends) is at most kr.final.financial_income_aggregation_threshold (KRW); bank and brokerage statements.

name: payer_resource_development
question: Does the payer carry on an overseas resource development business (Korea: Restriction of Special Taxation Act art. 22)?
meaning: KR CIT art. 18-4(1): for such a foreign subsidiary the holding threshold of the foreign dividend exclusion is 5% instead of 10%; the payer's business registration and project licences.

name: payee_controlled_by_nonresidents
question: Is the payee controlled, directly or indirectly, by one or more persons who are not residents of the payee's own jurisdiction?
meaning: Control test of the KR-VN agreement art. 28(3) (inserted by the Second Protocol 2019): treaty benefits are denied to such a resident; shareholder registers and voting agreements up the chain.

name: annual_dividends_local_ccy
question: What is the total of the dividends the individual receives in the tax year from companies resident in the jurisdiction whose rule is evaluated, this dividend included, in that jurisdiction's currency?
meaning: Yearly total for a threshold on an individual's dividends from resident companies: MY Schedule 1 Part XXII and Schedule 6 para 12B(2), RM100,000 of dividends deemed derived from Malaysia under s14, in MYR; in a combined assessment the spouse's are added (P.U.(A)148/2025 r2(3)). Dividend certificates of ITA s108(2), the return.

name: linked_presence_period
question: Is the individual's shorter presence in the tax year linked to a period of 182 or more consecutive days of presence in the immediately preceding or following tax year?
meaning: MY ITA s7(1)(b): a period of presence of less than 182 days linked by or to 182 or more consecutive days in the year before or after; temporary absences for service, ill health or social visits of up to 14 days in all count as presence. Immigration records, passport.

name: three_of_four_prior_years_present
question: In each of any three of the four tax years immediately preceding, was the individual either resident in the jurisdiction or present there for 90 days or more?
meaning: MY ITA s7(1)(c), together with 90 days or more of presence in the current year (my.residence.individual_90day_three_of_four_years). Earlier assessments, immigration records.

name: resident_next_and_prior_three_years
question: Is the individual resident in the jurisdiction in the following tax year, having been resident in each of the three tax years immediately preceding?
meaning: MY ITA s7(1)(d): resident in the following basis year and in each of the three preceding basis years. Earlier assessments, plans for the next year.

name: public_service_citizen_abroad
question: Is the individual a citizen employed in the public service or by a statutory authority who is not in the jurisdiction on any day of the tax year because of that employment abroad or an employer-sponsored course of study abroad?
meaning: MY ITA s7(1B): such a citizen is deemed resident for that year and later years of absence. Employment records.

name: partnership_business_income
question: Is the foreign dividend received in relation to a partnership business that the individual carries on in the jurisdiction?
meaning: MY: foreign dividends of a resident individual in relation to a partnership business in Malaysia fall under P.U.(A)235/2022 (participation or economic substance conditions), all other foreign income under the individual exemption of P.U.(A)234/2022. Partnership agreement, the partnership's accounts.

name: payee_banking_insurance_transport
question: Does the payee carry on the business of banking, insurance, or sea or air transport?
meaning: MY P.U.(A)235/2022 para 5: the foreign dividend exemption does not apply to a person carrying on such a business. Business licence, accounts.

name: payee_taxed_on_dividend
question: Is the payee subject to tax in its own jurisdiction on this dividend?
meaning: KR-MY treaty art. 10(3): the Malaysian exemption from additional tax on dividends applies to a resident of Korea who is subject to Korean tax in respect of the dividend. The payee's tax return or assessment.

name: business_gross_income_local_ccy
question: What is the payee's gross income from its business sources for the tax year, in the currency of its jurisdiction?
meaning: MY Schedule 1 Part I para 2A: the small-company rates apply only when the gross income from business sources of the basis period is at most RM50 million (my.final.sme_business_gross_income_max); accounts, the return.

name: related_company_holding_pct
question: What is the highest of these percentages of ordinary paid-up capital at the start of the tax year: the payee's capital owned, directly or indirectly, by a company with ordinary paid-up capital above the small-company limit; that company's capital owned by the payee; or the capital of both owned by another company?
meaning: MY Schedule 1 Part I para 2B(a)-(c) with the 'related company' of para 2C (ordinary paid-up capital above RM2.5 million, my.final.sme_related_company_paid_up_capital_min): above 50% (my.final.sme_related_company_holding_pct_max) the small-company rates do not apply; 0 when there is no such company. Shareholder registers, group chart.

name: foreign_holding_pct
question: What percentage of the payee's ordinary paid-up capital at the start of the tax year is owned, directly or indirectly, by companies incorporated outside its jurisdiction or by individuals who are not its citizens?
meaning: MY Schedule 1 Part I para 2B(d): above 20% (my.final.sme_foreign_holding_pct_max) the small-company rates do not apply. Shareholder register, group chart.

name: days_present_12m_from_arrival
question: How many days was the individual present in the jurisdiction during the 12 consecutive months counted from the first day of presence there?
meaning: Days of presence in the 12 consecutive months from the individual's first day of presence in the jurisdiction (VN PIT Law 2025 art. 2(2)(a): 183 days or more in a calendar year or in 12 consecutive months from the first day of presence); immigration records, passport stamps.

name: payee_sole_owner
question: Is the individual receiving the dividend the sole owner of the paying company (a single-member limited liability company owned by one individual, or a private enterprise)?
meaning: VN PIT Law 2025 art. 4(21): the income, after corporate income tax, of the individual owner of a private enterprise or of a single-member limited liability company is exempt; enterprise registration certificate naming the owner.

name: payer_income_payee_ccy
question: What is the payer's actual income for its financial year as the shareholder's CFC rule measures it (pre-tax profit, as adjusted), in the currency of the shareholder's jurisdiction?
meaning: KR ITCA art. 28(i) with Enforcement Decree arts. 61 and 64(1): the actual income of the specified foreign corporation (the average of its last three fiscal years, pre-tax profit with the adjustments of art. 61) converted at the basic or arbitrated exchange rate at the end of its year; at most KRW 200 million (kr.cfc.de_minimis_income_max) keeps the CFC rule out. The payer's accounts and returns; the conversion is the caller's.
